mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.avatar, SUM(CASE WHEN pl.level_name = 'A赏' THEN 10 WHEN pl.level_name = 'B赏' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN pl.level_name = 'A赏' THEN 1 END) AS a_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN pl.level_name = 'B赏' THEN 1 END) AS b_count, MAX(bbr.created_at) as max_obtain_time FROM shop_user u JOIN blind_box_records bbr ON u.user_id = bbr.user_id join product p on p.product_id = bbr.product_id join product_series ps on ps.series_id = bbr.series_id join product_level pl on pl.level_id = p.product_levelid WHERE pl.level_name IN ('A赏', 'B赏') and ps.is_spiritpower = 0 AND YEAR(bbr.created_at) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(bbr.created_at) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.avatar ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN pl.level_name = 'A赏' THEN 10 WHEN pl.level_name = 'B赏' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalPoints FROM blind_box_records bbr join product p on p.product_id = bbr.product_id join product_series ps on ps.series_id = bbr.series_id join product_level pl on pl.level_id = p.product_levelid WHERE pl.level_name IN ('A赏', 'B赏') and ps.is_spiritpower = 0 AND YEAR(bbr.created_at) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(bbr.created_at) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE)
